init.description: The sensors below are optional: pick them and this charger receives their values automatically.

data.log_pushes: Log every value sent to the charger

data_description.car_soc_entity: Your car's state of charge. Sent to the charger whenever it changes and used by the "Use car SOC" constraint.
data_description.home_battery_soc_entity: Your home battery's state of charge. Required for the charger to accept any home battery data.
data_description.home_battery_amps_entity: Your inverter's output AC current. Positive while the inverter injects, negative while it charges the battery, so pick a sensor that keeps the sign rather than an absolute value. Leave empty if you don't measure it.
data_description.home_battery_interval: Battery level alone: 30-60 seconds is fine. If you send inverter current, set it to the same rate as sensor polling and try to configure them as fast as possible. The charger follows that current to decide how much surplus goes to the car, a slow feed makes it react late. 60 seconds is the maximum, because the charger discards the data after that.
data_description.log_pushes: Troubleshooting only. Writes one line per send to Settings > System > Logs, so you can confirm what the charger receives. Leave off for normal use: at a short send interval this fills the log quickly.

set_car_soc.name: Set car SOC
set_car_soc.description: Sends the car's state of charge to the charger, for use as a charge constraint. Stays valid for 24 hours.

soc.name: State of charge
soc.description: Car state of charge in percent.

set_home_battery_soc.name: Set home battery SOC
set_home_battery_soc.description: Sends the home battery state of charge, and optionally its current, to the charger for use by solar charge mode. The charger discards this after 60 seconds, so repeat at least that often.

soc.name: State of charge
soc.description: Home battery state of charge in percent.

amps.name: Inverter load current
amps.description: Signed inverter load current in amps (pw_amps_now): positive while injecting, negative while charging the battery. The charger treats anything below -2 A as no surplus for the car. Omit if you don't measure it.
